newsitem.title: CHINA: China telecom chief urges cheaper mobile phones.
newsitem.headline: China telecom chief urges cheaper mobile phones.

text.p: China's Minister of Posts and Telecommunications has called for cheaper mobile telephones to try to boost the sector, the Economic Information Daily said on Wednesday.
Improving mobile telephone services were a major aspect of developing the telecommunications sector as a whole, the newspaper quoted Minister Wu Jichuan as saying.
"Mobile telephone development should focus on getting users to make more calls, therefore the excessively high prices of mobile telephones should be lowered," Wu said.
China had 6.2 million registered mobile phone users at the end of last October and industry officials estimate the number will reach 10 million in 1997 and 20 million by 2000.
